name: loader-fulgur
title: Fulgur loader
description: An electromagnetic pulse leaves a small emitter post. Its expanding front strains a wire grid clamped in a lit frame, lifting a narrow annular ridge; a weaker afterfront follows, and the next pulse leaves as the last one reaches the frame. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-tensor
title: Tensor loader
description: Two equal masses orbit in their own wells in a spacetime mesh. A quadrupolar ripple stretches one direction as it contracts the other, radiating outward twice per orbit, and an L-shaped detector at the mesh’s corner trades its arm lengths as each ripple passes. name: loader-duplex
title: Duplex loader
description: Two fixed exciters send coherent ripples across a lit square surface. title: Chirp loader
description: A sonar head sends a chirped front across its beam toward three solid reflectors, each casting a shadow in it.
